'''I4-M9''' was a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] that was owned by the [[Shistavanen/Legends|Shistavanen]] [[Blik (Shistavanen)|Blik]] during the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. When Blik traveled to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Caarimon]], he brought I4 with him, aboard his [[Starship/Legends|starship]], the ''[[Ku'Amo]]''. However, due to space limitations aboard the ''Ku'Amo'', I4 had to remain deactivated while he was aboard it.
